tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Also the inner window of the product frame.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Soft bands: the Features section, the product frame bezel, table headers, the active sidebar item.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and icon tiles that sit on surface-soft.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: nav and footer borders, section borders, card and table borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of outlined (secondary) buttons, the menu button and the selected segment. Light value is the source value and is 1.5:1 on surface: allowed because the button label identifies the control. Do not use it for input borders; use line-input. Dark value meets 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: line-input
tokens.usage: Border of text inputs. The border alone shows where the field is, so it meets 3:1 on surface and surface-soft in both themes (light 3.3:1, dark 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text, on surface, surface-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Nav links, outlined button labels, feature icons, the neutral badge label, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, body copy in sections, table metadata, footer, field hints, on any surface (5.2:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in inputs, on surface. Lighter than ink so it reads as a sample, still 5.0:1 (light) and 5.3:1 (dark). Never use it for real content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE accent, set per product (the data-accent attribute). Primary button fill, logo mark tile. Replace with one of the accent-option tokens.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icons on an accent fill. White with violet, teal and orange (5.1:1 or more). With accent-option-ink in dark, #101828. The data-accent attribute sets it.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text: eyebrow labels, accent badge labels, text links, plan check marks, the focus ring. Each option has its own text value per theme, 4.5:1 or more on surface, surface-soft and accent-soft. The data-accent attribute sets it together with accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Pale accent tint behind accent-text (the New badge).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success badge label (Approved, Active), on success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning badge label (In review, Pending), on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the border of an invalid input, on surface (6.6:1 light, 9.7:1 dark); the danger badge label on danger-soft. Always pair it with an icon and words, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge background.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral badge background (Draft). Label is ink-secondary.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: The dark call-to-action block. In dark theme it is a raised panel with a line border so it stays visible.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Headings on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Body text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: inverse-line
tokens.usage: Outlined button border on inverse-surface. Light value is the source value (2.3:1); the label carries the meaning.

tokens.name: inverse-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the call-to-action block. Invisible in light; in dark it is the line border that keeps the raised panel apart from the page.

tokens.name: accent-option-violet
tokens.usage: Accent option 1 (default). Fill #5b4ee8 with a white label (5.7:1). accent-text: the fill in light, #a49cf5 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-option-teal
tokens.usage: Accent option 2. Fill #0e7c66 with a white label (5.1:1). accent-text: #0b6e5a in light (5.5:1 on accent-soft), #5cc9ac in dark.

tokens.name: accent-option-orange
tokens.usage: Accent option 3. Fill #b9470f (darkened from #d4561c so a white label is 5.3:1 at any size). accent-text: the same in light (4.7:1 on accent-soft, 5.1:1 on surface-soft), #f08a5d in dark.

tokens.name: accent-option-ink
tokens.usage: Accent option 4, monochrome. In dark theme the fill flips to near-white: set on-accent to #101828 and accent-text to #f5f5f6.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Marketing headings. Tight tracking, weight 600. Never bold for headings.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stat cards; table cell padding (vertical 14px is the one exception).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between hero elements; nav item groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side gutter; feature grid row gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Feature grid column gap.

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between section header and its grid.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Padding inside the call-to-action block.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

radius.note: Soft, square-ish. Pills only for badges and the announcement.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Sidebar items inside the product mock; small logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the 32px logo mark.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Icon tiles (48px); the inner window of the product frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards: stat cards, tables, framed feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Product frame bezel and the call-to-action block.

tokens.name: radius-full

shadow.note: Two shadows. Buttons, tiles and cards get xs; only the product frame floats.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon tiles, stat cards.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The product preview frame only.

tokens.name: lead-max

tokens.name: icon-tile
